title: Bring SAP support knowledge into the conversation
fact: FastGPT describes an internal support assistant combining SAP documentation, FAQ retrieval and ticket handoff. The publisher reports that 70% of repetitive inquiries were handled automatically.
signalLabel: repetitive inquiries automated, as reported by FastGPT
pilot: Start with one support topic and an approved FAQ. Evaluate cited answers, missing-information handling and a ticket draft reviewed by the employee.
measure: Correct answers, supported citations, appropriate handoffs and total handling time including review.

title: Turn inconsistent part numbers into structured data
fact: FastGPT describes a workflow that interprets component part numbers, extracts fields and connects the structured output to an enterprise database. No numerical accuracy claim is reproduced here.
pilot: Use synthetic or approved RFQs to extract the original part number, requested quantity and missing information. Match only against approved product data; a person confirms substitutions and pricing.
measure: Field-level correctness, missing-field detection, traceability to the input and review time.

title: Give procurement a reviewable supplier shortlist
fact: FastGPT describes supplier matching using business records and supplier information, with risk flags to assist procurement screening.
pilot: Define one purchasing category, approved supplier records and explicit eligibility rules. Return a sourced shortlist for the procurement team to assess.
measure: Evidence coverage, rule compliance, reviewer agreement and time spent on initial screening.

title: Move service requests from conversations to a brief
fact: FastGPT describes extracting customer requirements from conversations and routing them to regional designers, with support for additional visual context.
signalLabel: conversation details prepared for service routing
pilot: Choose one intake channel. Extract the customer's request, identify missing fields and prepare a routing suggestion for a service coordinator.
measure: Required-field completeness, correct routing, review effort and exceptions.

title: Answer routine questions and hand over the rest
fact: FastGPT describes a course-information and enrollment FAQ assistant with multi-turn clarification and human handoff. The publisher reports a 42% reduction in human handoff rate.
signalLabel: lower human handoff rate, as reported by FastGPT
pilot: Evaluate routine product or service questions with one approved FAQ set. Route account-specific, uncertain and high-impact requests to a person.
measure: Answer quality, appropriate handoff and time per correctly resolved request. Handoff reduction alone is not the goal.

title: Make internal knowledge easier to find within access rules
client: 上海邮电设计咨询研究院
fact: FastGPT describes policy-document retrieval and project-data queries with organizational access boundaries. This reference illustrates a governance requirement rather than a CNPS security certification.
pilot: Start with two test roles and a limited document set. Enforce access before retrieval and use read-only, approved data queries.
measure: Authorized retrieval, denial of restricted requests, citation quality and auditability.

title: Prepare document checks for human review
fact: FastGPT describes preliminary document checks embedded in an existing approval process, with exceptions sent for human review.
signalLabel: policy checks within an approval workflow
pilot: Apply explicit rules to an approved set of non-sensitive sample documents. Produce a review checklist and supporting references; authorized staff retain financial decisions.
measure: Rule coverage, false flags, missed exceptions and reviewer time.

title: Connect service questions with operational knowledge
fact: FastGPT describes a logistics operator combining customer-service knowledge and internal reference material in a conversational support workflow.
signalLabel: service questions and internal document lookup
pilot: Apply the general support pattern to a customer's own permitted logistics workflows. Keep transactional records behind identity checks and escalate uncertain service commitments.
measure: Supported answers, role-appropriate access, exception handling and total resolution time.
